title: GitHub - xhjkl/please: A polite LLM for CLI 🙏
excerpt: A polite LLM for CLI 🙏. Contribute to xhjkl/please development by creating an account on GitHub.
content_html:
🙏🙏🙏

A command-line tool that lets you interact with your terminal in natural language. All inference stays local.

The name is chosen so that the invocation reads like a natural-language phrase.

Installation

First, install the tool itself. You can get it from Homebrew:

$ brew install xhjkl/made/please

Or with the installer script:

# either the above, or this:
$ curl -fsSL xhjkl.xyz/please | sh

Then, download the weights just once:

$ please load

And, optionally, verify them:

$ cd ~/.please/weights
$ shasum -a 256 Inkling-2-Mini-IQ4_NL.gguf
cbdf3fa9dc50a4124977980f37da4f1fa764b0cfe800d275cd43d26ce2a81af4  Inkling-2-Mini-IQ4_NL.gguf

Usage

$ git diff --cached | please summarize to a concise commit message
$ please take the creds from Justfile and make a fuzzer one-off script > fuzz.ts
$ please format all the git-staged files
$ please tar the current folder but without git-ignored files
$ please resolve all the merge conflicts in the current folder
$ please fix all clippy diagnostics

Bridging

You can run please in a different environment, such as a remote shell or a container, while keeping inference and weights on your machine. This avoids copying weights around and lets you keep using your local compute power. For a remote machine, set up SSH socket forwarding as described in BRIDGING.md; for a Docker container, mount the host socket into the container as described in DOCKER.md.
